title: Fusion energy from the National Ignition Facility's best shots, 2021 to 2025
description: Bar chart in megajoules of fusion energy per shot: 1.3 on 8 August 2021 (below the laser energy of about 1.9); 3.15 on 5 December 2022, from 2.05 megajoules of laser light, the first to exceed it; 3.88 on 30 July 2023; 5.2 in February 2024, from 2.2; 5.0 on 23 February 2025; 8.6 on 7 April 2025, from 2.08, a target gain of about 4.1. Data: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory and Wikipedia, National Ignition Facility.
